scientific_integrity: The established crossing-annulus existence criterion and focus-flight period methodology are cited as prior work. The exact enclosed Euclidean area identity and period-area asymptotic are the assessed contribution; finite numerical tests do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the specified reversible two-zone focus family, positive coefficients and transverse crossing cycles; nontransverse Filippov behavior, all other orbits and arbitrary piecewise affine fields are not classified. Potential equivalent unindexed area derivations remain a priority risk.
title: Exact enclosed-area law and sharp period–area gap in a reversible two-zone focus center
